question: Who composed the play ‘Mrichchhakatika’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shudraka.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mrichchhakatika:-**

 
 
• It is a **Sanskrit play**, also known as **'The Little Clay Cart'. **
 
• It is believed to have been written by **Shudraka, a playwright** who lived in ancient India in the **5th century CE**.
 
• The play is a romantic comedy that tells the story of a **poor Brahmin named Charudatta **and his love for a courtesan named **Vasantasena.**
 
• Shudraka is considered one of the** greatest playwrights of ancient India,** along with Kalidasa and Bhasa.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sudraka was a king and a scholar, believed to have lived around the 3rd century CE.
 
• "Mrichchhakatika" is notable for its realistic portrayal of society and its departure from the more idealistic themes of earlier Sanskrit drama.
 
• The play also provides a glimpse into the economic and social conditions of the time, including the life of courtesans and the struggles of the lower classes.
 
• It has been translated into numerous languages and adapted into various forms, including theater and film.
 
• The play's themes of love, sacrifice, and justice continue to resonate with audiences today.
